title: St. James Day School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. · March 14–18, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing St. James Day School’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Arrival in Washington, D.C. & the Smithsonian Museums

  • Flight from LIT to DCA (airfare is not included in the cost of the trip)
  • Welcome to Washington, D.C.! Meet your Landmark Tour Director at baggage claim
  • Lunch allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
  • Dinner
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 2: The National Mall & the United States Capitol

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Staff-led tour of the Capitol Building with a member of the Senator’s staff
  • Lunch allocation
  • Group exploration of the Smithsonian Museums
  • Sit-down dinner allocation
  • Evening on your own — explore the city with friends, or walk around the Georgetown area
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: The National Archives & The People’s House

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Visit The FBI Experience
  • Lunch allocation
  • Visit the American Dream Experience
  • Visit The People’s House
  • Sit-down dinner allocation
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 4: Arlington National Cemetery & Air and Space

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Tour Director–led walking tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Lunch allocation
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
  • Visit the National Museum of the American Indian
  • Dinner allocation
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 5: The Tidal Basin Memorials & Departure

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Check out and leave luggage at the front desk
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Boxed lunch
  • Depart for home
introHeading: St. James Day School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From the marble steps of the United States Capitol to the quiet rows of Arlington National Cemetery, this trip brings American history and civics to life at every turn. Students will take a staff-led tour of the Capitol, stand before the Lincoln, Vietnam, Korean War, and World War II Memorials, explore the Smithsonian museums and the National Archives, and step inside The People’s House. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
